custom_vars.description: A list of key-value pairs to set as script variables via the -o flag. Used to customize internal behavior (e.g., ASCII art sources). Items are flat maps with 'key' and 'value' strings.

custom_vars_items.description: Item structure for custom_vars list. Not used directly as type in schema, but defines the flat map for items above.

display_info.description: List of information blocks to display. Valid values include: kernel, distro, uptime, shell, packages, memory, cpu, gpu, wm, de, localip, publicip, bssid, ssid, battery, etc. Prefix with '-' to remove if in default set.

colors_string.description: String argument for -c flag. Format: [0-9][0-9],[0-9][0-9]. First part is logo/label color, second is text color.

no_ascii.description: If true, adds the -n flag to suppress ASCII distribution logo.

portrait.description: If true, adds the -p flag to output in portrait mode.

no_color.description: If true, adds the -N flag to strip all color from output.

verbose.description: If true, adds the -v flag for verbose output.

screenshot.description: If true, adds the -s flag to take a screenshot upon displaying info.

upload_host.description: If screenshot is enabled, specifies the upload host (teknik, imgur, mediacrush, hmp) via the -u flag. Empty string disables specific host selection.
